plain: A Swedish UFO researcher named Clas Svahn says he tracked down the people behind every Swedish UFO photograph from the 1970s. According to him, the photographers admitted they had faked their pictures, except for one man, Christ Sunstrom, who still stands by his. He told this to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2026.
